description: Checkout's review of the whole cart in the current buying context, as printdash.io's checkout shows it: every line with its artwork state and Printdash's file notices, delivery to a saved address (address_id, else the default) or pickup where the account has it, the order reference (required, up to 50 characters), notes, a PO number for a Team on account, is_whitelabel (Remove Printdash Branding), the totals from Printdash's own delivery pricing, expected_total, and what placing it will do: placed unpaid with a pay link on printdash.io, on the Team's account, or held for a Team owner's approval. When it is ready, the summary and a confirmation_token for place_order. Writes nothing; nothing is ordered until place_order is called after the customer agrees. Printdash prints in Australia and delivers within Australia only; prices are in AUD and include GST. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

address_id.description: A saved address id for delivery (list_addresses). Omit for the context's default address.

fulfilment.description: pickup only where the account has it (pickup_available).

is_whitelabel.description: Remove Printdash Branding, as the checkout switch. Default false.

notes.description: Notes for Printdash's team about this order.

payment_method.description: A request: a Team with approved terms orders on account unless card is asked for; Printdash decides.

po_number.description: A Team on account: the purchase order number (required when the Team says so).

reference.description: The order reference, required as at checkout: a name for this order. Kept to 50 characters.

name: prepare_checkout

expected_total.description: The total the customer is shown; place_order is refused if Printdash's own total differs.

level.description: attention: production would come back to the customer about it. info: handled, for their information.

locked.description: A line from a quote Printdash priced: its price and spec are fixed by the quote.

outcome.description: pay_link: placed unpaid, paid on printdash.io. on_account: invoiced to the Team. needs_approval: held for a Team owner.

summary.description: Show this to the customer exactly as written before placing the order.

title: Review the cart before ordering
